row.name: Language Talent
row.description: You have an ear for language. Every language you buy with points is spoken one fluency step higher than the level you paid for (Broken speaks as Accented, Accented as Fluent). Languages granted free - a native tongue, Bilingual, Polyglot - are unaffected. Facilitates espionage, trade, or communication with obscure factions across the diverse galaxy.
